missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Характер' is the nominative subject within the possession frame 'у неё'. 'Сильный' is the agreeing masculine adjective describing the trait.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. As an inanimate masculine, 'характер' is unchanged in the accusative as the object of 'знаю'. 'Его' shows whose character, and 'хорошо' adds the degree.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. The phrase 'нет' requires the genitive, giving 'характера'. 'Твёрдого' agrees in the masculine genitive, denying a firm character.
Strategic focus: Dative after благодаря. The preposition 'благодаря' governs the dative 'характеру'. The clause credits the success to his character.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after обладать. The verb 'обладать' requires the instrumental, giving 'характером'. 'Спокойным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. After 'в' the noun takes the prepositional form 'характере'. 'Много упрямства' uses the genitive after a quantity word.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with genitive modifier. 'Характер' is the nominative subject, and 'человека' is genitive, showing whose. 'Виден' is the short masculine predicate.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Характеры' is the nominative plural in the possession frame 'у них'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'совершенно' intensifies the contrast.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural with quantifier. 'Характеры' is nominative plural; 'у всех детей' puts both words in the genitive after the quantifier 'всех'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Характер' is the accusative object of 'показал', unchanged because it is inanimate masculine. 'Этот случай' is the nominative subject.
